card.name: Linking words before island or place names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before a proper place name, mostly islands, atolls and remote sites, in lists or phrases like 'three on' or 'summit of'.

modes.label: Lists of islands
modes.description: Commas or 'and' inside a list of island or atoll names, just before the next name.
modes.example: Martha’s Vineyard, Nantucket<<,>> the Elizabeth Islands, and Monomoy

modes.label: Preposition before a place
modes.description: A preposition or 'nearby' that leads into a named island, mountain or site.
modes.example: There are three<< on>> Maui. Other sites include Kameah

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting a proper place name, though the promoted tokens are mixed and unclear.
